projects.name: ZenData
projects.title: ZenData — Automated Data Quality & Semantic Hygiene Platform
projects.description: 4-Pillar Data Health Audit Engine & semantic hygiene pipeline that evaluates datasets, reconciles financial formulas, and generates executive PDF/Excel audit scorecards.
projects.readmeExcerpt: ZenData brings peace, clarity, and mathematical rigor to chaotic tabular data. A modern, web-based SaaS platform engineered for analysts and businesses to drag & drop raw messy spreadsheets, run automated multi-pillar health audits, preview interactive data corrections, and ex...
highlights: Engineered a 4-Pillar Data Health Audit Engine evaluating Completeness, Uniqueness, Validity, and Statistical Consistency (1.5x IQR outlier detection) for 0–100% quality scores.
Implemented Semantic Hygiene & Anti-Poisoning Rules in Pandas to purge sentinel placeholders and cluster categorical typos without fabricating missing PII.
Designed Mathematical Reconciliation Logic cross-validating financial formulas (Total = Qty x Price x (1 - Discount)) to reverse-engineer corrupted totals.
Automated Executive Reporting Pipelines with ReportLab and OpenPyXL to generate landscape PDF scorecards and 3-sheet styled Excel workbooks.

projects.name: trustlink
projects.title: TrustLink — Enterprise Identity & SSO Platform (OAuth 2.0 & OIDC)
projects.role: SLT Internship — Core Identity & Security Lead
projects.description: Full-stack OAuth 2.0 & OpenID Connect Single Sign-On identity provider with passwordless FIDO2/WebAuthn passkeys, PKCE, signed JWTs, and automated risk scoring.
projects.readmeExcerpt: Enterprise-grade Identity Provider (IdP) supporting Authorization Code Flow + PKCE, FIDO2/WebAuthn hardware & platform passkeys, and real-time suspicious login risk scoring with a React + Redux Toolkit admin console.
highlights: Developed a full-stack OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect identity provider with Authorization Code Flow + PKCE, signed JWTs and JWKS discovery, and refresh token rotation.
Integrated passwordless FIDO2/WebAuthn passkeys and Email/SMS OTP verification to enable single sign-on across enterprise telecom services.
Designed a sign-in activity and security logging pipeline with automated risk scoring and suspicious-login email alerts.
Built a React, Redux Toolkit and Tailwind CSS admin console with role-based access control, analytics dashboards and light/dark theming.
Containerized the platform with Docker and Nginx, and applied security hardening including rate limiting and vulnerability scanning.

projects.name: loan-approval-prediction
projects.title: Loan Approval Prediction System
projects.description: End-to-end machine learning classification pipeline predicting loan approvals across 58,645 financial records with 99.97% accuracy and 1.0 AUC-ROC.
projects.readmeExcerpt: Financial machine learning classification pipeline trained on 58,645 records, benchmarking Logistic Regression, Gaussian Naive Bayes, and KNN with 5-fold GridSearchCV hyperparameter tuning.
highlights: Built an end-to-end ML classification pipeline in Python (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, Plotly) to predict loan approvals on a 58,645-record financial dataset.
Performed EDA and cleaned the data — missing value imputation, outlier capping via IQR, feature encoding, and scaling — to engineer a model-ready dataset.
Trained Logistic Regression, Gaussian Naive Bayes, and KNN classifiers with a stratified train-test split, achieving up to 99.97% accuracy and an AUC-ROC of 1.0.
Optimised model performance using GridSearchCV with 5-fold cross-validation across multiple hyperparameter combinations.

highlights: Developed a Python-based incident response tool to monitor server access logs and detect unauthorized access attempts.
Utilized data mining techniques and dictionary structures to track IP behavior and authentication statuses in real time.
Implemented a threat-detection threshold to automatically flag potential brute-force attacks for firewall blocking.
